units.text: Article 93
units.label: Art. 93

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation may be removed from office, and a President who has ceased exercising powers may be deprived of immunity, by the Federation Council only on the basis of a charge of high treason or commission of another serious crime brought by the State Duma, confirmed by an opinion of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation that the actions of the incumbent or former President contain elements of a crime, and by an opinion of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation that the prescribed procedure for bringing the charge has been observed.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 93

units.text: 2. The State Duma's decision to bring a charge and the Federation Council's decision to remove the President of the Russian Federation from office or deprive a former President of immunity must be adopted by votes of two-thirds of the total membership of the respective chambers — senators of the Russian Federation and deputies of the State Duma — on the initiative of at least one-third of the deputies of the State Duma and with an opinion from a special commission established by the State Duma.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 93

units.text: 3. The Federation Council's decision to remove the President of the Russian Federation from office or deprive a former President of immunity must be adopted no later than three months after the State Duma brings a charge against the President. If the Federation Council does not adopt a decision within that period, the charge against the incumbent or former President of the Russian Federation is deemed rejected.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 93

units.text: CHAPTER 5. FEDERAL ASSEMBLY
units.label: CHAPTER 5. FEDERAL ASSEMBLY

units.text: Article 94
units.label: Art. 94

units.text: The Federal Assembly — the parliament of the Russian Federation — is the representative and legislative body of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 94 · text

units.text: Article 95
units.label: Art. 95

units.text: 1. The Federal Assembly consists of two chambers — the Federation Council and the State Duma.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 95

units.text: 2. The Federation Council consists of senators of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 95

units.text: The Federation Council comprises:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 95 · “The Federation Council comprises:”

units.text: а) two representatives from each constituent entity of the Russian Federation, one from its legislative (representative) and one from its executive body of state authority, for the term of the respective body;
units.label: Point «а» Part 2 Art. 95

units.text: б) a President of the Russian Federation who has ceased exercising powers because of the expiry of the term of office or prematurely because of resignation, for life. Such a former President of the Russian Federation is entitled to decline the powers of a senator of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «б» Part 2 Art. 95

units.text: в) no more than 30 representatives of the Russian Federation appointed by the President of the Russian Federation, of whom no more than seven may be appointed for life.
units.label: Point «в» Part 2 Art. 95

units.text: 3. The total number of senators of the Russian Federation is determined by the number of representatives from the constituent entities of the Russian Federation listed in Article 65 of the Constitution of the Russian Federation and the number of persons exercising the powers of senators of the Russian Federation referred to in points ‘б’ and ‘в’ of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 95

units.text: 4. A senator of the Russian Federation may be a citizen of the Russian Federation who has reached 30 years of age, permanently resides in the Russian Federation and holds neither foreign citizenship nor a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State. In the manner established by federal law, senators of the Russian Federation are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits) or keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 95

units.text: 5. Citizens with outstanding services to the country in state and public activity may be appointed representatives of the Russian Federation in the Federation Council exercising the powers of senators of the Russian Federation for life.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 95

units.text: 6. Representatives of the Russian Federation in the Federation Council, except those exercising the powers of senators of the Russian Federation for life, are appointed for a term of six years.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 95

units.text: 7. The State Duma consists of 450 deputies.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 95

units.text: Article 96
units.label: Art. 96

units.text: 1. The State Duma is elected for a term of five years <20>.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 96

units.text: 2. The procedure for forming the Federation Council and the procedure for electing deputies of the State Duma are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 96

units.text: <20> Part 1 is reproduced as amended by the Law of the Russian Federation on an Amendment to the Constitution of the Russian Federation No. 6-ФКЗ of 30 December 2008, ‘On Changing the Terms of Office of the President of the Russian Federation and the State Duma’, which entered into force on the date of its official publication, 31 December 2008 (Rossiyskaya Gazeta, 2008, 31 December). It applies to a State Duma elected after the entry into force of that Law.
units.label: Art. 96 · “<20> Part 1 is reproduced as amended by the Law of the Russian…”

units.text: Article 97
units.label: Art. 97

units.text: 1. A citizen of the Russian Federation who has reached 21 years of age, is entitled to participate in elections, permanently resides in the Russian Federation and holds neither foreign citizenship nor a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State may be elected a deputy of the State Duma. In the manner established by federal law, deputies of the State Duma are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits) or keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 97

units.text: 2. The same person may not simultaneously be a senator of the Russian Federation and a deputy of the State Duma. A deputy of the State Duma may not be a deputy of other representative bodies of state authority or local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 97

units.text: 3. Deputies of the State Duma work on a permanent professional basis. They may not be in state service or engage in other paid activities except teaching, scientific and other creative activities.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 97

units.text: Article 98
units.label: Art. 98

units.text: 1. Senators of the Russian Federation and deputies of the State Duma enjoy immunity throughout their terms of office. They may not be detained, arrested or searched except when apprehended at the scene of a crime, nor subjected to a personal inspection except where federal law provides for this to ensure other people's safety.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 98

units.text: 2. The question of deprivation of immunity is decided by the relevant chamber of the Federal Assembly on the submission of the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 98

units.text: Article 99
units.label: Art. 99

units.text: 1. The Federal Assembly is a permanently functioning body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 99

units.text: 2. The State Duma meets for its first sitting on the thirtieth day after its election. The President of the Russian Federation may convene a sitting of the State Duma before that date.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 3. The first sitting of the State Duma is opened by its oldest deputy.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: 4. When the State Duma of a new convocation begins work, the powers of the State Duma of the previous convocation cease.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 99

units.text: Article 100
units.label: Art. 100

units.text: 1. The Federation Council and the State Duma meet separately.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 100

units.text: 2. Sittings of the Federation Council and the State Duma are open. A chamber may hold closed sittings in cases provided for by its rules of procedure.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 100

units.text: 3. The chambers may meet jointly to hear messages from the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 100

units.text: Article 101
units.label: Art. 101

units.text: 1. The Federation Council elects from among its members its Chairman and Deputy Chairmen. The State Duma elects from among its members its Chairman and Deputy Chairmen.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 101

units.text: 2. The Chairman and Deputy Chairmen of the Federation Council and the Chairman and Deputy Chairmen of the State Duma preside over sittings and administer the internal proceedings of their chamber.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 101

units.text: 3. The Federation Council and the State Duma establish committees and commissions and hold parliamentary hearings on matters within their jurisdiction.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 101

units.text: 4. Each chamber adopts its own rules of procedure and decides matters concerning the internal organization of its activities.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 101

units.text: 5. To supervise execution of the federal budget, the Federation Council and the State Duma establish the Accounts Chamber, whose composition and operating procedure are determined by federal law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 101

units.text: Article 102
units.label: Art. 102

units.text: 1. The Federation Council has jurisdiction over:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: а) approval of changes to boundaries between constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «а» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: б) approval of a decree of the President of the Russian Federation introducing martial law;
units.label: Point «б» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: в) approval of a decree of the President of the Russian Federation introducing a state of emergency;
units.label: Point «в» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: г) deciding whether the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation may be used outside the territory of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «г» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: д) calling the election of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «д» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: е) removal of the President of the Russian Federation from office; deprivation of immunity of a President of the Russian Federation who has ceased exercising powers;
units.label: Point «е» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: ж) appointment, on the submission of the President of the Russian Federation, of the Chairman, Deputy Chairman and judges of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation and the Chairman, Deputy Chairmen and judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «ж» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: з) consultations on candidates proposed by the President of the Russian Federation for the offices of Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation, Deputy Prosecutors General of the Russian Federation, prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and prosecutors of military and other specialized procuracies equivalent to prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «з» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: и) appointment and removal of the Chairman of the Accounts Chamber and half of its total number of auditors on the submission of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «и» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: к) consultations on candidates proposed by the President of the Russian Federation for heads of federal executive bodies (including federal ministers) responsible for defence, state security, internal affairs, justice, foreign affairs, prevention of emergencies and elimination of the consequences of natural disasters, and public safety;
units.label: Point «к» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: л) termination, on the submission of the President of the Russian Federation and in accordance with federal constitutional law, of the powers of the Chairman, Deputy Chairman and judges of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation, the Chairman, Deputy Chairmen and judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, and chairmen, deputy chairmen and judges of cassation and appellate courts, if they commit an act disgracing a judge's honour and dignity, or in other cases provided for by federal constitutional law indicating that a judge is unable to exercise their powers;
units.label: Point «л» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: м) hearing annual reports of the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation on the state of legality and law and order in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point «м» Part 1 Art. 102

units.text: 2. The Federation Council adopts resolutions on matters assigned to its jurisdiction by the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 102

units.text: 3. Resolutions of the Federation Council are adopted by a majority of the total number of senators of the Russian Federation, unless the Constitution of the Russian Federation provides for another decision-making procedure.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 102

units.text: Article 103
units.label: Art. 103

units.text: 1. The State Duma has jurisdiction over:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 103

units.text: а) approval, on the submission of the President of the Russian Federation, of the candidate for Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «а» Part 1 Art. 103
